s1.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness with fever and shortness of breath
salient_findings: Oxygen saturation of 85% on room air
Coarse rales at the lung bases bilaterally
key_facts: Nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction
Bilateral multifocal pneumonia on chest radiography
Low amplitudes and Q waves in leads V1 to V3 on precordial leads

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness with fever and shortness of breath
salient_findings: Oxygen saturation of 85% on room air
Coarse rales at the lung bases bilaterally
key_facts: Nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction
Bilateral multifocal pneumonia on chest radiography
Low amplitudes and Q waves in leads V1 to V3 on precordial leads

shortlist.label: COVID-19
shortlist.why_kept: Nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction and symptoms of fever, anosmia, and shortness of breath

shortlist.label: Influenza pneumonia
shortlist.why_kept: Symptoms of fever, shortness of breath, and bilateral multifocal pneumonia on chest radiography

shortlist.label: Pneumococcal pneumonia
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral multifocal pneumonia on chest radiography and severity of symptoms

shortlist.label: Staphylococcal pneumonia
shortlist.why_kept: Severe symptoms and bilateral multifocal pneumonia on chest radiography

shortlist.label: Acute respiratory distress syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Severe shortness of breath, low oxygen saturation, and bilateral multifocal pneumonia on chest radiography

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including fever, anosmia, and shortness of breath, combined with a nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction and bilateral multifocal pneumonia on chest radiography, are consistent with COVID-19.

rejected.label: Influenza pneumonia
rejected.why: While influenza pneumonia could explain some symptoms, the nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction is more specific for COVID-19.

rejected.label: Pneumococcal pneumonia
rejected.why: Pneumococcal pneumonia typically presents with lobar consolidation on imaging, which does not match the bilateral multifocal pattern seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Staphylococcal pneumonia
rejected.why: Staphylococcal pneumonia often presents with more severe disease and cavitation on imaging, which is not described in this case.

rejected.label: Acute respiratory distress syndrome
rejected.why: While the patient has severe respiratory symptoms, acute respiratory distress syndrome is a syndrome rather than a primary diagnosis and does not explain the underlying cause of the patient's symptoms.
